scripts.restart: npm run stop && npm run start
scripts.restart:persistent: npm run stop:persistent && npm run start:persistent
scripts.restart:fresh: npm run stop:fresh && npm run start:fresh
scripts.test: docker-compose exec frontend npm run test
scripts.test:watch: docker-compose exec frontend npm run test:watch
scripts.test:coverage: docker-compose exec frontend npm run test:coverage
scripts.test:backend: docker-compose exec web poetry run pytest tunescript_app/tests
